title: Cowboys and Quinnen Williams Agree to Contract Extension
description: Multiple sports news outlets report that the Dallas Cowboys and defensive tackle Quinnen Williams have agreed to a three-year contract extension worth $105.9 million.

sections.heading: Contract Terms
paragraphs: According to ESPN, the Cowboys and Quinnen Williams have reached a three-year deal valued at $105.9 million. NFL.com corroborates this figure, noting it is a contract extension. The Dallas Cowboys official site confirms that the team and Williams agreed to terms on a three-year extension.

sections.heading: Reporting Sources
paragraphs: The agreement was covered by major sports news organizations. ESPN cited sources regarding the specific financial details. NFL.com attributed the information to NFL Network. Additionally, the Dallas Cowboys official site provided confirmation of the agreement.
